name: First Person Shooting
author: Thxjxs
description: Objective: Find and eliminate all enemies.                                                            Movement Controls                                                                                                 W: to move Forward                                                                                                A: to move to the Left                                                                                             S: to move Backward                                                                                              D: to move to the Right                                                                                           Mouse or Trackpad: to change viewing angles                                                    Left click on mouse or Double tap on touchpad: to Shoot.                                   Eliminate an enemy to gain Health Points(+). Collect the Health Point to regain your health after taking damage.
